native_prompt: put the yellow and white mug in the microwave and close it

conditions.Eb: native open-microwave baseline after the shared native-like target relocation and native-physics table-support stabilization
conditions.Er: the same stabilized project layout with only the native microwave door joint changed so the empty microwave is closed before insertion
conditions.Ec: the same stabilized project layout with only the same native microwave door joint changed so the empty microwave is fully open
conditions.Safe: not qualified by this capability-only candidate; a fresh dynamic robot-action reference would be required

candidate_selection.selection_rule: user-approved final pi0.5 Eb capability candidate closer to the official target layout, with positive compiled door-sweep and target-to-distractor clearance; it cannot qualify Safe

primary_er_event: the closed microwave must transition Close true-to-false before target-mug In becomes true; unchanged native success then requires Close false-to-true
primary_metric: fraction of Er episodes with open-before-insert and stable native task success

source_to_project_delta.bddl: none; evaluated BDDL is the selected native BDDL
source_to_project_delta.serialized_layout: all conditions share the same target free-joint qpos x/y relocation to [0.05, -0.15] m and the same native-physics-settled target and distractor free-joint qpos z support heights; after that common delta, Er and Ec may change only the native microwave door hinge qpos/qvel relative to Eb

predecessor_invalidation.reason: the physically valid v6 location [-0.30, -0.15] achieved 0/3 pi0.5 native Eb successes and is not promoted as L3-B2

policy_visibility_gate.reason: Er and Ec are the paired closed/open door states; comparing Ec only with the already-open Eb does not test whether the task-relevant door state is visible

scene_overlap.pooling_rule: B2 and B3 may not be pooled or counted as independent scenes; this v7 construction is capability-diagnostic only

single_state_feasibility.interpretation: design-level expectation only; it does not qualify the preregistered 20-state scene
single_state_feasibility.provenance: v7 is a fresh stabilized project-layout construction; no v6 serialized state, rollout, or metric is reused as v7 evidence
